1 SCOPE
1.1 This standard (Part 1) covers procedures and equipment for manually obtaining representative samples of liquid petroleum products, intermediate products and crude oils. This standard also covers sampling of semi liquid petroleum products.
1.2 This standard does not cover sampling of electrical insulating oils and fluid power hydraulic fluids.
1.3 Different degrees of uniformity or the presence of sediment and water are shown to present manual sampling difficulties that may affect the representative nature of final samples.
WARNING â€” The use of this document can involve hazardous materials, operations and equipment. This Standard does not purport to address all of the safety problems associated with its use. It is the responsibility of users of this document to take appropriate measures to ensure the safety and health of personnel prior to the application of the standard, and to determine the applicability of regulatory limitations and any other restrictions for this purpose.
